title: Add one interactive island
summary: An island is a component that receives browser JavaScript only when a client directive asks for it.
introduction: An island is a component that receives browser JavaScript only when a client directive asks for it. Your task: Explain which part of the page needs client JavaScript.
learningObjectives: Explain which part of the page needs client JavaScript.
Explain the example for add one interactive island

blocks.text: An island is a component that receives browser JavaScript only when a client directive asks for it. The rest of the page can stay plain HTML.
Use an Astro project. Save examples at the shown src paths. Astro files are built into HTML and need the Astro tool; they do not run as plain HTML in this playground.

blocks.title: Add one interactive island

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `client:load` asks Astro to load and hydrate this island in the browser. Other page content can remain static HTML.

blocks.text: The React counter becomes interactive when its JavaScript loads. The heading stays ordinary static HTML.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Install the matching Astro integration and create Counter first. Importing a component without a client directive does not make it interactive.
